reconstruction_choices: Exact saved seed51005 F025 Amzn/C04 geometry and original schedule copied verbatim; input source paths are provenance only and are not read during the workload.

Only this flight is replayed, admitted at simulator t=0 instead of its saved t=68; original_scenario_time_s adds the saved actual entry time for comparison, without claiming identical global timer phase.
Default route construction, PaperPerformance and no-wind/no-noise/no-CR/no-CD/no-VNAV settings match nr_pilot. Native fly-by, bank and speed remain unchanged unless --bank-deg is supplied.
A supplied --bank-deg changes native ap.bankdef before adding waypoints and is always labeled diagnostic_bank_override; it is not a validated baseline change or a real-aircraft bank envelope.
Every 0.25-second native step is recorded, including initial and terminal states. Arrival requires the last waypoint active and endpoint distance <=25 m; timeout remains an explicit failure.

Width exposure uses NR post-step distance >76.2 m times dt. Crossing times are adjacent-sample brackets, not interpolated continuous-time events. Bank-limit settings and heading-rate-derived equivalent bank are distinct fields.
